guard: Freeze on share holds AT the share for inputs, and a journal seeded from serialized entries freezes its replayed results. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: effect inputs stay writable after the dispatch, the shipped defect
mutations.expectRed: an effect's input is frozen AT the share: mutating it afterwards is L2031
mutations.completionMarker: ok a workflow's catch does not swallow a divergence
mutations.cell: an effect's input is frozen AT the share: mutating it afterwards is L2031
mutations.note: Without the freeze the program mutates the fact it just shared and the run's value disagrees with its recorded hash — the measured pre-fix behavior.

mutations.name: a seeded journal hands back thawed deserialized results, the shipped defect
mutations.expectRed: a replayed result out of a SERIALIZED journal is frozen again: writing it is L2031
mutations.completionMarker: ok an effect's input is frozen AT the share: mutating it afterwards is L2031
mutations.cell: a replayed result out of a SERIALIZED journal is frozen again: writing it is L2031
mutations.note: The live path freezes before settle, so only the JSON round trip exposes this: parsed entries are fresh writable objects, and replay returned them as-is.
